summary: IGT's KMS, PRIME, sync file and sync object tests that tests/graphics/igt-76.list names, one test program a case, on vkms, std-vga and virtio-vga on the GNU root, each judged subtest by subtest against the Debian reference guest's stored run on the same profile; the runner is tests/graphics/runners/igt.sh and the scenario tests/cases/machine/graphics_scenario.c

cases.behavior: IGT's core_getversion, the subtests tests/graphics/igt-76.list names, run by igt_runner as root on vkms, which rach2.vkms on the boot line starts, with no display device through Rach2's vkms, give each subtest Linux's result in the Debian reference guest on the same QEMU profile: each pass a pass and each skip a skip

execution.privileges: the runner runs as root in the guest, which it needs to be the card's master
execution.cleanup: libetude-case stops the machine and removes the overlay, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot an overlay of the GNU system's disk on AHCI with rach2.root=ext2 rach2.vkms and no display device and vkms, wait for the root and the login prompt, log in as root at the console and open the framed guest channel
make /tmp/graphics and copy there from the read-only graphics data disk the runners, the guest's environment, the IGT list and the Debian references, owned by the test account
run igt.sh core_getversion as root with GRAPHICS_CLASS=conformance and GRAPHICS_DONE=1, through the framed guest channel
run judge.py results on the test's results and the Debian reference's
fetch the runner's output as the evidence out.tar.gz and write the host's half of the record, its load and the admission ledger's claims, as the evidence host-record
